entries.name: A.J. Brown
entries.summary: Brown (hamstring) has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Chargers, Doug Kyed of the Boston Herald reports.

entries.name: Bhayshul Tuten
entries.summary: Tuten (ankle) wasn't spotted at Friday's practice, Demetrius Harvey of the Florida Times-Union reports.

entries.name: Brevin Jordan
entries.summary: Jordan (foot) has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Ravens.

entries.name: Brock Purdy
entries.summary: Head coach Kyle Shanahan said Friday that Purdy (ankle) has been ruled out for Sunday's game versus the Seahawks, Jennifer Lee Chan of NBC Sports Bay Area reports.

entries.name: Carson Beck
entries.summary: Beck (back) will not play Sunday against the Commanders, coach Mike LaFleur said Friday, Josh Weinfuss of ESPN.com reports.

entries.name: Case Keenum
entries.summary: Keenum (coach's decision) is inactive and tabbed as the Bears' emergency third quarterback Thursday in Detroit.

entries.name: Dallen Bentley
entries.summary: inactive

entries.name: Davis Allen
entries.summary: Allen (ankle) will be placed on injured reserve, Greg Beacham of the Associated Press reports.

entries.name: Drake Maye
entries.summary: For now, Maye -- who suffered a fractured right fibula during a Week 10 loss to the Lions -- remains on the Patriots' 53-man roster rather than injured reserve, with coach Mike Vrabel citing the "balance" the team is hoping to strike with regard to managing its remaining designated to return from IR slots, Mike Reiss of ESPN.com reports.

entries.name: Drew Allar
entries.summary: Allar (coach's decision) is inactive for Friday's game against the Broncos but will serve as Pittsburgh's emergency third QB.

entries.name: Eli Heidenreich
entries.summary: inactive

entries.name: Garrett Nussmeier
entries.summary: Nussmeier (coach's decision) is inactive but will serve as the Chiefs' emergency third quarterback against the Bills on Thursday.

entries.name: Grant Calcaterra
entries.summary: inactive

entries.name: Jahan Dotson
entries.summary: Dotson (hamstring) wasn't spotted at practice Friday, Daniel Flick of the Atlanta Journal-Constitution reports.

entries.name: Jake Ferguson
entries.summary: inactive

entries.name: Jared Wayne
entries.summary: Wayne (quadriceps) has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Jets.

entries.name: Jonathan Mingo
entries.summary: Mingo (ankle) has been ruled out for Thursday's game against the Eagles.

entries.name: Jordan Addison
entries.summary: Addison (thumb) has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Falcons, Dane Mizutani of the St. Paul Pioneer Press reports.

entries.name: Jordan Watkins
entries.summary: Watkins (groin) has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Seahawks.

entries.name: Josh Jacobs
entries.summary: Jacobs (finger) is listed as inactive Wednesday at the Rams, Tom Pelissero of Netflix reports.

entries.name: Justin Herbert
entries.summary: Herbert (concussion) has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Patriots.

entries.name: Juwan Johnson
entries.summary: Johnson (hamstring) has been ruled out for Sunday's game at Cincinnati, Katherine Terrell of ESPN.com reports.

entries.name: Kaden Wetjen
entries.summary: Wetjen (coach's decision) is inactive Friday against the Broncos.

entries.name: Kayshon Boutte
entries.summary: Boutte (hip) has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Ravens.

entries.name: Keaton Mitchell
entries.summary: Mitchell (knee) has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Patriots.

entries.name: Kenneth Walker III
entries.summary: inactive

entries.name: Lil'Jordan Humphrey
entries.summary: inactive

entries.name: Luke Musgrave
entries.summary: Packers head coach Matt LaFleur said Saturday that he doesn't anticipate Musgrove (neck) returning from the PUP list this season, according to NFL reporter Jason B. Hirschhorn.

entries.name: Omar Cooper Jr.
entries.summary: Head coach Aaron Glenn announced Friday that Cooper (ankle/groin) will remain out for Sunday's game against the Dolphins, Brian Costello of the New York Post reports.

entries.name: Parker Washington
entries.summary: Washington (shoulder) will be out for Sunday's game against the Titans and is considered week-to-week moving forward, Demetrius Harvey of the Florida Times-Union reports.

entries.name: Roschon Johnson
entries.summary: Johnson (ankle) has been ruled out  for Thursday's game against the Lions.

entries.name: Sam Ehlinger
entries.summary: Ehlinger (coach's decision) is inactive for Friday's game against the Steelers but will work as Denver's emergency third QB.

entries.name: Seth McGowan
entries.summary: McGowan (hamstring) has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Giants.

entries.name: Skyler Bell
entries.summary: inactive

entries.name: Ty Simpson
entries.summary: Simpson (coach's decision) is inactive but will serve as the Rams' emergency third quarterback against the Packers on Wednesday, Adam Grosbard of The Orange County Register reports.

entries.name: Will Mallory
entries.summary: Mallory (hamstring) has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Giants.

entries.name: Zachariah Branch
entries.summary: Branch (hamstring) has been ruled out for Sunday's game at Minnesota, Will McFadden of the Falcons' official site reports.

entries.name: Brenen Thompson
entries.summary: Thompson (hamstring) is listed as doubtful for Sunday's game against the Patriots, Omar Navarro of the Chargers' official site reports.

entries.name: Colston Loveland
entries.summary: Loveland (knee) is expected to avoid being placed on injured reserve and is considered week-to-week, Adam Schefter of ESPN reports.

entries.name: Brock Bowers
entries.summary: Bowers (ankle) will be listed as questionable for Sunday night's game against the Browns, Adam Hill of the Las Vegas Review-Journal reports.

entries.name: Caleb Williams
entries.summary: Williams said after Thursday's 39-35 win in Detroit that he's "fine" and likely just has "a bruise on his abdomen," Jason Lieser of the Chicago Sun-Times reports.

entries.name: Christian Watson
entries.summary: Watson (concussion) has been ruled out for the rest of Wednesday's game against the Rams.

entries.name: Dallas Goedert
entries.summary: Goedert (shoulder) had his right arm in a sling following Thursday's 39-38 victory over the Cowboys, Jimmy Kempski of PhillyVoice.com reports.

entries.name: David Njoku
entries.summary: Njoku (shoulder) is listed as questionable for Sunday's game against New England.

entries.name: Denzel Boston
entries.summary: Boston (quadriceps) wasn't present for Friday's practice, Mary Kay Cabot of the Cleveland Plain Dealerreports.

entries.name: DeVonta Smith
entries.summary: Smith (back) was seen limping badly in the locker room after Thursday's 39-38 win over the Cowboys, Martin Frank of the Delaware News Journal reports.

entries.name: Drew Ogletree
entries.summary: Ogletree (knee) is officially listed as questionable for Sunday's game versus the Giants.

entries.name: Feleipe Franks
entries.summary: Franks (wrist) was a limited participant at practice Friday.

entries.name: Hunter Long
entries.summary: Long (ankle) is questionable for Sunday's game against the Commanders, Bo Brack of GoPHNX.com reports.

entries.name: Jalen Royals
entries.summary: Head coach Andy Reid said Royals suffered a sprained ankle during Thursday's 13-10 loss in Buffalo, Charles Goldman of AtoZSports.com reports.

entries.name: Mike Evans
entries.summary: Evans (Achilles) is listed as questionable for Sunday's contest against the Seahawks, Matt Maiocco of NBC Sports Bay Area reports.

entries.name: Noah Fant
entries.summary: Fant (calf) is questionable for Sunday's game against the Bengals, while Juwan Johnson (hamstring) has been ruled out, Matthew Paras of the New Orleans Times-Picayune reports.

entries.name: Saquon Barkley
entries.summary: Barkley suffered a stinger during Thursday's game in Dallas.

entries.name: Tee Higgins
entries.summary: After not practicing Friday, Higgins (hamstring) is listed as questionable for Sunday's game against the Saints, Katherine Terrell of ESPN.com reports.

entries.name: Tez Johnson
entries.summary: Johnson did not participate in Friday's practice due to an illness.

entries.name: Tyler Higbee
entries.summary: Higbee has been diagnosed with a pulmonary contusion that he sustained in the Rams' 26-13 win over the Packers in Week 12, and his status for Week 13 against the Chiefs on Thursday, Dec. 3 won't be known until Wednesday, Adam Grosbard of The Orange County Register reports.

entries.name: Alec Pierce
entries.summary: When addressing the press Wednesday, Pierce (heel) noted that the offseason procedure he underwent this past March was done because he was dealing with heel pain that impacted his Achilles, Kevin Bowen of 107.5 The Fan Indianapolis reports.

entries.name: Andrei Iosivas
entries.summary: Iosivas (thumb) is questionable for Sunday's game against the Saints.

entries.name: Ben Skowronek
entries.summary: The Steelers placed Skowronek (calf) on injured reserve Thursday, Teresa Varley of the team's official site reports.

entries.name: Caleb Lohner
entries.summary: Lohner (foot) has been ruled out for Friday's game against the Steelers.

entries.name: Davante Adams
entries.summary: The Rams are not expected to open the 21-day practice window for Adams (hamstring) ahead of the team's Week 13 game against the Chiefs, Nate Adkins of The Athletic reports.

entries.name: De'Zhaun Stribling
entries.summary: San Francisco head coach Kyle Shanahan said Wednesday that Stribling (ankle) is likely at least "a couple weeks away" from returning to practice, Harrison Rich of the San Francisco Chronicle reports. "I don't know. I mean, nothing's changed," Shanahan said, regarding a timeline for the rookie receiver.

entries.name: George Holani
entries.summary: The Seahawks placed Holani (knee) on injured reserve Monday, John Boyle of the team's official site reports.

entries.name: Jalen McMillan
entries.summary: McMillan (knee) is listed as questionable for Monday's game against the Panthers, Scott Smith of the Buccaneers' official site reports.

entries.name: Jeremiyah Love
entries.summary: Head coach Mike LaFleur said Friday that he has no update on Love (ankle), who is eligible to come off injured reserve following Sunday's game against the Commanders, Bo Brack of GoPHNX.com reports.

entries.name: Jonathon Brooks
entries.summary: Brooks (groin) is listed as questionable for Monday's game against the Buccaneers, Sheena Quick of Fox Sports Radio 1340 reports.

entries.name: Malik Willis
entries.summary: Head coach Jeff Hafley said Monday that, at this time, surgery to address Willis' groin/core injury is not foreseen, Joe Schad of The Palm Beach Post reports.

entries.name: Romeo Doubs
entries.summary: Doubs (shoulder), who remains on injured reserve, has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Chargers.

entries.name: J.K. Dobbins
entries.summary: The Broncos placed Dobbins on the reserve/suspended list Wednesday, Zac Stevens of TheDNVR.com reports.
